text: 参考方案区分外部计算设备运行程序、背包内开发部署，以及按需适配预设应用三种使用方向。接入版主控暂定 Orin Nano 8GB，板载版暂定 Orin NX 16GB；这些是规划参数，尚非已验证规格。
基础 SDK、驱动与文档属于规划交付说明；ROS 2、DDS 与 Python 接口范围、存储容量、Web 功能及记录范围仍待验证或确认。应用示例限已验证组合，并需安装与标定，不代表所有外设或应用已交付。

originalEvidence.text: - **基础接入版**：面向已有工作站或计算设备的团队，交付接入硬件、基础 SDK、驱动与文档；外部设备运行客户程序，背包提供数据与控制接口。
- **板载开发版**：提供算力平台、基础 SDK 与开发环境，在背包内开发与部署程序，通过 SSH 或本机接口接入。
- **板载应用版**：开发版全部内容加选配应用包，通过 Web 使用预设程序，通过开放接口进行二次开发。
- 主控暂定：接入版 Orin Nano 8GB，板载开发版与应用版 Orin NX 16GB。存储规格、应用性能、基础 Web 与记录范围待验证 / 确认。
- 应用包限已验证的 G1、外设与软件组合，需必要安装与标定；二次开发范围按应用包约定。应用示例不代表所有组合已经交付。

text: 集中供电与保护、CAN / RS-485 / Ethernet / USB 均为规划方案。电压、功率、取电方式、接口数量和电气规格没有确认数值；不能从概念图推导。
换装构想要求暂停任务、安全停稳、外设独立断电，换装后加载对应配置。G1+ 适配、分路供电控制与热插拔仍待验证；不将设计目标表述为带电换装能力。

- 页面中的即插即用是已适配组合的设计目标，不意味着任意设备兼容或带电热插拔。

newMessages.研究演示 · AI-CDR Center（Center for Artifici: Research demonstration · AI-CDR Center (Center for Artificial Intelligence and Cross-Domain Robotics)
newMessages.头显与两个手柄提供头部、双手输入；来源说明通过摇杆控制前后移动，无需脚踝追踪器。: A headset and two controllers provide head and hand inputs. The source describes joystick control for forward and backward movement, without ankle trackers.
newMessages.来源将此模式链接至 SONIC Link 三点方案；视频未确认采集设备具体型号、: The source links this mode to the SONIC Link three-point solution. The clip does not establish the exact tracking hardware, software version or use of RoboDock.
newMessages.来源列出头显、双手柄与脚踝追踪器，画面展示操作者与 G1 的抬臂、抬腿和平衡动作: The source lists a headset, two controllers and ankle trackers. The footage shows an operator and G1 raising arms and legs and performing balance motions.
newMessages.来源链接 SONIC Link 全身方案；这是受控场地研究演示，不证明任意动作复: The source links to the SONIC Link full-body solution. This controlled-site research demo does not establish arbitrary motion reproduction, general stability or RoboDock integration.
newMessages.来源说明使用单目相机捕捉人体动作，画面中操作者未佩戴头显或手柄，G1 配合展示上: The source describes monocular motion capture. The footage shows an operator without a headset or controllers alongside G1 performing arm and body motions.
newMessages.相关演示候选：未找到此模式与当前 SONIC Link 软件或 RoboDock: Related demonstration candidate: no explicit mapping to current SONIC Link software or RoboDock was found. Camera model and deployment conditions remain unconfirmed.
newMessages.画面展示佩戴 VR 设备的操作者引导 G1 俯身抓取并提起玩偶。该片段也以 te: The footage shows a VR-equipped operator guiding G1 to bend down, grasp and lift a plush toy. The same clip appears as teleoperation-demo.mp4 in one-g-website, with an identical content hash.
newMessages.仅说明人工遥操作抓取验证；未证明自主搬运、载荷、节拍或由 RoboDock 驱动: This illustrates manual teleoperation grasping validation only. It does not establish autonomous handling, payload, cycle time or operation through RoboDock.
newMessages.来源将此片段描述为舞蹈视频动作复现；画面展示 G1 在室内完成连续舞蹈动作。: The source describes motion recreation from a dance video. The footage shows G1 performing a continuous dance sequence indoors.
newMessages.相关研究演示；片段未展示输入视频、处理流程或训练方法，不等于自主规划，也未确认属: Related research demo. The clip does not show the input video, processing pipeline or training method. It does not establish autonomous planning or inclusion in a SONIC Link application package.
newMessages.来源描述音乐驱动全身动作；实际画面为虚拟场景中的人形模型舞动，并非真实设备实拍。: The source describes music-driven full-body motion. The actual footage shows a humanoid model dancing in a virtual scene, rather than a physical robot recording.
newMessages.仅作仿真研究展示；未确认模型权属、算法交付或与 SONIC Link、RoboD: Simulation research display only. Model ownership, algorithm delivery and integration with SONIC Link or RoboDock are unconfirmed. This does not establish general intelligence or autonomous task capability.
newMessages.画面展示佩戴 VR 设备的操作者引导 G1 俯身抓取并提起玩偶。来源将其归为全身: The footage shows a VR-equipped operator guiding G1 to bend down, grasp and lift a plush toy. The source presents it as a full-body teleoperation reaching and picking demo.
newMessages.视频暂时无法加载，请稍后重试或查看来源说明。: The video could not be loaded. Please retry later or see the source notes.
newMessages.视频无法播放时可查看来源说明。: If the video cannot play, see the source notes.
newMessages.前两项 VR 模式有来源中的 SONIC Link 方案链接；单摄像头属于相关研: The first two VR modes have source links to SONIC Link solutions; single-camera control is related research with an unconfirmed solution mapping. These demos provide no device-control interface.
newMessages.以下为相关研究演示，不是已交付的自主任务或通用智能功能。: These are related research demos, not delivered autonomous-task or general-intelligence capabilities.
newMessages.概念图依据团队草图生成，安装草图用于讨论背部安装、专用线束与手腕连接件；两者均不: The concept rendering was generated from the team sketch. The installation sketch supports discussion of back mounting, dedicated wiring and wrist connectors. Neither establishes the final structure, port count or delivered hardware.
newMessages.计算与外设接入 · 规划说明: Compute and peripheral connections · Planning notes
newMessages.参考方案区分外部计算设备运行程序、背包内开发部署，以及按需适配预设应用三种使用方: The reference distinguishes programs running on external compute, onboard development and deployment, and adaptation of preset applications. Proposed controllers are Orin Nano 8GB for access and Orin NX 16GB for onboard versions. These are planning parameters, not validated specifications.
newMessages.基础 SDK、驱动与文档属于规划交付说明；ROS 2、DDS 与 Python: The basic SDK, drivers and documentation are described as planned deliverables. ROS 2, DDS and Python interface scope, storage capacity, Web functions and recording scope still require validation or confirmation. Application examples are limited to validated combinations and require installation and calibration; they do not establish delivery of every peripheral or application.
newMessages.集中供电与保护、CAN / RS-485 / Ethernet / USB 均为: Centralized power and protection, CAN / RS-485 / Ethernet / USB are planned. Voltage, power, power source, port counts and electrical specifications have no confirmed values and cannot be inferred from the concept rendering.
newMessages.换装构想要求暂停任务、安全停稳、外设独立断电，换装后加载对应配置。G1+ 适配、: The replacement concept requires pausing the task, reaching a safe stop, powering down the peripheral independently and loading its configuration after replacement. G1+ adaptation, branch power control and hot swapping still need validation; the design goal is not a claim of live replacement capability.
newMessages.早期控制台界面演示 · 截图中的状态与检查记录不证明已连接真实后台或设备。三点“: Early console UI demonstration · Status indicators and check records in the screenshot do not establish a connection to a real backend or device. The three-point development label is historical; GEM is outside this solution. The delivered interface and operating conditions remain unconfirmed.
newMessages.ROS 2、DDS 与 Python 接口范围待确认。: The scope of ROS 2, DDS and Python interfaces remains unconfirmed.
